content: The ex-factory starting price of the Honda Civic Standard variant in Pakistan is PKR 8,499,000.
The ex-factory starting price of the Honda Civic Oriel variant in Pakistan is PKR 8,834,000.
The ex-factory starting price of the Honda Civic RS variant in Pakistan is PKR 10,100,000.
The ex-factory starting price of the Honda HR-V VTI variant in Pakistan is PKR 7,549,000.
The ex-factory starting price of the Honda HR-V VTI-S variant in Pakistan is PKR 7,799,000.
The ex-factory starting price of the Honda HR-V e:HEV (Hybrid) variant in Pakistan is PKR 10,369,000.
The ex-factory starting price of the Honda City 1.2LS variant in Pakistan is PKR 4,737,000.
The ex-factory starting price of the Honda City Aspire 1.5LAS variant in Pakistan is PKR 6,069,000.
The ex-factory starting price of the Honda City Aspire S 1.5LAS CVT variant in Pakistan is PKR 6,149,000.
All Honda Civic variants feature a 1.5L VTEC Turbo engine, a Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT), a seamless sunroof, and the standard Honda Sensing safety suite.

Specifications for the Honda Civic Standard: 1.5L VTEC Turbo engine generating 127 HP and 180 Nm of torque; ECON and Normal driving modes; 16-inch steel wheels; Halogen projector headlights; 7-inch touch screen infotainment; fabric seats; sunroof; and Honda Sensing safety suite.

Specifications for the Honda Civic Oriel: 1.5L VTEC Turbo engine generating 127 HP and 180 Nm of torque; ECON and Normal driving modes; 16-inch alloy wheels; Halogen projector headlights; 9-inch navigation infotainment display; Hi-Grade seats; sunroof; and Honda Sensing safety suite.

Specifications for the Honda Civic RS (flagship): High-output 1.5L VTEC Turbo engine generating 176 HP and 220 Nm of torque; ECON, Normal, and Sport driving modes; 17-inch matte black alloy wheels; LED headlights; 9-inch navigation infotainment display; perforated leather seats; sunroof; and Honda Sensing safety suite.
All Honda HR-V variants come standard with the Honda Sensing safety suite, an Electric Parking Brake with Auto Brake Hold, Hill Descent Control, and Hill Start Assist.

Specifications for the Honda HR-V VTI: 1.5L naturally aspirated petrol engine producing 119 HP; CVT automatic transmission; 17-inch grey alloy wheels; 9-inch touch screen infotainment system; fabric seats; 4 airbags; and standard safety features.

Specifications for the Honda HR-V VTI-S: 1.5L naturally aspirated petrol engine producing 119 HP; CVT automatic transmission; 17-inch black cut alloy wheels; 9-inch navigation system; leather seats; 4 airbags; and upgraded technology package.

Specifications for the Honda HR-V e:HEV (Hybrid): 1.5L Hybrid powertrain producing 131 HP paired with an E-CVT transmission; 18-inch black cut alloy wheels; 9-inch navigation infotainment system; leather seats; 6 airbags; and an exclusive hands-free Power Tailgate.
All Honda City variants come equipped with Dual SRS Airbags, Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), and ISOFIX child seat anchor mounts.

Specifications for the Honda City 1.2LS: 1.2L petrol engine generating 88 HP; 15-inch steel wheels; Halogen headlights without fog lights; 7-inch touch screen infotainment system; fabric seats; and a micro-pole antenna.

Specifications for the Honda City Aspire 1.5LAS: 1.5L engine generating 118 HP; 15-inch alloy wheels; Halogen headlights with bulb fog lights; 9-inch navigation display; Hi-Grade seats; Push Start button; and Automatic Climate Control (Auto AC).

Specifications for the Honda City Aspire S 1.5LAS CVT: 1.5L engine producing 118 HP with CVT transmission; 15-inch alloy wheels; Premium LED headlights; LED fog lights; 9-inch navigation display; Hi-Grade seats; Push Start; and Auto AC.
